notes:
EXP34-C ORACLE COVERAGE, PART B (strict-only keys), sqlite: src/treeview.c through src/vdbeapi.c. These 140 keys are in-scope EXP34-C findings that aurora-lint d21be1b3d reports only at the strict preset (run sqc-0.6.0-d21be1b3d-strict-*; strict sets first_site_only=false and reports every dereference site, not only the first) and that no label covers. Same standard and method as coverage-exp34c-2026-10-calibration and coverage-exp34c-2026-10-part-a-curl-hostap-mbedtls-mosquitto: the dereference is the violation site, judged at strict under EXP34-C/2026-10-07/presets; FP needs proof in the scanned source, a language guarantee, or an ISO C or POSIX library contract (those rows also cite P/facts); open caller sets for exported functions; a strippable assert, a noreturn attribute and an earlier dereference of the same pointer are not proof. A later site inherits an earlier site's FP only when that proof also dominates it with no reassignment between. One read-only research reader drafted each verdict at source in the pinned checkout; the adjudicator reviewed every draft (format and vocabulary, every nearby opposite-verdict label, a source re-read of a sample and of the questioned rows) before inclusion.

RESULT: 67 FP, 73 TP.

FP shapes: sqlite3TreeViewSelect's do/while on a tested p; out2Prerelease and other address-of results in vdbe.c; dominating tests; struct-field invariants (medium). TP shapes: parameters of open utf.c, util.c, vdbe.c and public sqlite3_value_type/sqlite3_bind_value functions with only asserts; NEVER()/ALWAYS()-only tests in trigger.c; vtab pModule read from module-owned storage (medium); sqlite3_set_auxdata's pVdbe, zeroed in the finalize and aggregate-value contexts an application callback can receive.

12 row(s) name a conflict in provenance with a carried-forward label that predates the 2026-10-07 rulings; existing rows are not edited.

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision or recall claim is made here.
